settings.visualStyle: Grounded historical reconstruction of the Battle of Guandu, 200 CE, experienced only from a chest-mounted first-person perspective of an ordinary infantryman in Cao Cao's army. Close, crowded, obstructed battlefield framing with shields, spear shafts, earthworks, dust, smoke, unstable footing and fatigue. No wuxia, no fantasy, no game HUD, no centered FPS weapon and no wide cinematic battlefield showcase.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Every scene uses chest-mounted first-person POV. Scene N end state must physically equal Scene N+1 start state. No spoken human voice, no words, no commands, no dialogue, no chanting, no narration and no music. Human vocal sound is limited to breathing and brief nonverbal exertion only.

audioHardLock.promptRule: Do not generate spoken human voices or intelligible language in any scene.

rules: Most soldiers are not attacking at the exact same moment.
Men seek cover, hesitate, stumble, compress formation and lose visibility.
Missile fire forces shields and crouching.
Close combat is brief, crowded and confusing rather than elegant duels.
Cavalry remains at practical distance and never charges directly into the camera.
The POV may fall, kneel, stop or retreat a few steps when pressure becomes overwhelming.

continuityLock.rule: Scene N continuityEndFrame must physically match Scene N+1 continuityStartState.

movie.storyTitle: EP02 — Battle of Guandu, 200 CE: Hold the Line
movie.plotDetails: An anonymous infantryman in Cao Cao's army experiences sustained frontline fighting at Guandu. He never understands the entire strategic picture; he only experiences arrows, shield pressure, earthworks, crossbow support, short spear clashes, a counterpush, cavalry movement at distance, falling, regrouping and holding position.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a continuous serious battlefield episode at Guandu in 200 CE from chest-mounted first-person POV of an ordinary infantryman in Cao Cao's army. Keep the frame close, crowded and partially obstructed. No wide battlefield showcase, no third-person camera, no heroic choreography. No spoken human voices, no words, no commands, no dialogue, no chanting, no narration and no music. Human vocal sound is limited to breathing and brief nonverbal exertion only.
movie.storySummary: Already at the front, the soldier waits behind earthworks as arrows cross overhead. His unit advances across broken ground, is forced low by missile fire, receives crossbow support, closes behind shields, reaches a ditch and palisade, survives a cramped spear clash and enemy pressure, glimpses cavalry through dust, falls, regroups, joins a second push, helps another soldier move back and ends still holding position as fighting continues.

povSubject.name: Anonymous Cao Infantryman
povSubject.cameraRelation: viewer sees from this soldier's chest-mounted first-person perspective

characters.name: Nearby Cao Infantry
characters.description: Tired late Eastern Han infantry using shields, spears, earthworks and short coordinated movement without posing.

characters.name: Cao Crossbow Team
characters.description: Crossbowmen working from low cover with practical staggered firing and reload behavior.

characters.name: Yuan Shao Infantry
characters.description: Organized opposing late Eastern Han troops, mostly obscured by dust, cover and distance.

atmosphereAssets.title: Frontline Earthworks
atmosphereAssets.description: Packed earth, wooden cover, shallow ditches and crowded infantry positions.

atmosphereAssets.title: Ditch and Palisade Approach
atmosphereAssets.description: Broken stakes, churned ground, shallow ditch, wooden defenses and restricted movement.

atmosphereAssets.title: Dusty Flank Ground
atmosphereAssets.description: Broken earth, dust, passing cavalry at distance and scattered infantry cover.

atmosphereAssets.title: Narrow Breach and Held Position
atmosphereAssets.description: Cramped earthwork gap, broken wood, shields, low cover and dusk haze.

scenes.title: Already Under Fire
scenes.actionDescription: The POV is already crouched behind packed earth while nearby infantry keep low as isolated arrows strike dirt and shields.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted first-person POV inside a cramped Cao infantry earthwork, nearby backs and shoulders filling foreground, shield rims and spear shafts at frame edges, packed earth close, dust and impacts, no wide view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Begin crouched behind frontline cover. React to a few arrow impacts without seeing the enemy clearly. Camera motion follows torso and breathing. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Arrow flight, dirt impacts, wood impacts, gear and breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Advance Across Broken Ground
scenes.actionDescription: The POV rises and advances only a short distance with nearby soldiers across churned ground.
scenes.imageDescription: Close chest-mounted POV behind nearby soldiers moving across broken earth, shields and shoulders blocking much of the frame, broken stakes near the feet.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rise with the group and move in short uneven steps. No synchronized charge, no battlefield panorama. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Boots, dirt, shield movement, gear and breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Arrow Volley
scenes.actionDescription: A loose wave of arrows forces men down at different times behind shields and terrain.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV under incoming arrows, uneven shield heights, nearby bodies crouching, dust from impacts and restricted visibility.
scenes.videoPrompt: Drop lower and raise the shield so it blocks part of the frame. Do not anticipate impacts. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Arrow impacts, shield thumps, dirt, boots and heavy breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Crossbows Answer
scenes.actionDescription: Nearby crossbowmen rise just enough to aim through gaps and release staggered shots while the POV stays low.
scenes.imageDescription: Close chest-mounted POV beside a crossbow team, shoulders, shield edges and wooden mechanisms crowding the frame, earthworks ahead only partly visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Stay low and watch a few staggered releases and practical reload motions. No clean firing-line tableau. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Crossbow mechanisms, bolt release, wood, gear and breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Shield Line Closes
scenes.actionDescription: The POV is pressed into an uneven shield line as nearby soldiers crowd shoulder-to-shoulder.
scenes.imageDescription: Claustrophobic chest-mounted POV from inside a dense shield line, shield rims, spear shafts, shoulders and helmet edges filling most of the frame, mud and dust below, no panoramic formation view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Advance only a short distance while being physically pushed by nearby men. Camera bumps from body pressure and unstable footing. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Shield scraping, spear shafts, boots, armor movement and heavy breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Into the Ditch
scenes.actionDescription: The front ranks drop into a shallow ditch and the POV follows, stumbling on broken ground.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV descending awkwardly into a shallow battlefield ditch, nearby shields and legs filling the frame, broken stakes and churned earth at close range.
scenes.videoPrompt: Step down unevenly, brace with the body and recover balance behind others. Keep framing cramped. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Boots sliding in dirt, shield knocks, wood, gear and breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Palisade Pressure
scenes.actionDescription: The infantry pushes at a narrow damaged section of wooden defense while enemy movement appears only through gaps.
scenes.imageDescription: Close chest-mounted POV inside a ditch under a broken palisade, wood fragments, shields, spear shafts and nearby shoulders dominating frame; opposing figures only brief and partial.
scenes.videoPrompt: Press forward through a narrow gap with no clean duel and no acrobatics. Keep enemy visibility brief and obstructed. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Wood impacts, shields, weapon contact, boots and heavy breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Brief Spear Clash
scenes.actionDescription: A brief close contact occurs through the narrow breach; the POV sees fragments of spear shafts, shields and bodies rather than a clean opponent.
scenes.imageDescription: Very close chest-mounted battlefield POV, spear shafts crossing frame edges, shield impact, nearby soldiers blocking most of the view, no choreographed duel.
scenes.videoPrompt: Keep contact brief, crowded and difficult to read. The POV braces, recoils and shifts behind another soldier. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Shield and wood impacts, weapon contact, boots and nonverbal exertion only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Enemy Counterpush
scenes.actionDescription: Pressure from the other side forces the line back a few steps inside the ditch.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV being pushed backward by friendly bodies and shields, dust and wood fragments at close range, opposing troops mostly hidden.
scenes.videoPrompt: Move backward awkwardly under physical pressure rather than a clean retreat. Camera reacts with torso and footing. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Shield pressure, sliding boots, wood, gear and heavy breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Cavalry Through Dust
scenes.actionDescription: Through a narrow opening between nearby soldiers, mounted movement crosses a distant flank and disappears in dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted close POV with nearby shoulders and shield edges foreground; only a brief partial glimpse of cavalry at distance through dust, no grand charge view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Glance toward movement through a narrow gap, see only a few horses briefly, then lose them behind dust and people. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Distant hoofbeats, gear, wind, dust and breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Down in the Mud
scenes.actionDescription: The POV loses footing and falls, momentarily seeing mud, boots, shield edges and legs at ground level.
scenes.imageDescription: Ground-level chest-mounted first-person view after a fall, muddy earth inches away, nearby boots and shield rims crossing frame, no battlefield overview.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fall abruptly with believable body motion, pause low, then begin to recover. No cinematic tumble and no external view. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Impact into mud, gear scrape, boots nearby and heavy breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Regroup Behind Earth
scenes.actionDescription: The POV gets up into low cover where exhausted soldiers reset shields and equipment.
scenes.imageDescription: Close chest-mounted POV behind a low earth mound among tired Cao infantry, shoulders, shields and dusty hands filling frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Recover from the fall and crouch behind earth cover. Nearby men adjust gear and catch breath. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Heavy breathing, cloth, gear adjustment, dirt and distant impacts only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Second Push Through Breach
scenes.actionDescription: Under crossbow cover, nearby infantry move through a narrow opening and the POV follows closely behind shields.
scenes.imageDescription: Chest-mounted POV following closely through a narrow earthwork breach, shields, backs and broken wood dominating frame, no wide battle view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Move a few meters through the breach behind others. Keep the view obstructed by bodies and shields. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Crossbow releases, boots, shields, wood, gear and breathing only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Help Him Back
scenes.actionDescription: The POV helps a nearby soldier move backward into cover while missile impacts continue around the position.
scenes.imageDescription: Close chest-mounted POV using forearms to support another soldier behind low earth and broken wood, non-graphic, crowded battlefield framing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use body-weight movement to help the soldier a few steps back. Keep the action practical and non-graphic. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Heavy breathing, dragging steps, gear, dirt and nearby impacts only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.

scenes.title: Hold Until Dusk
scenes.actionDescription: The POV stays low behind the contested earthwork with exhausted soldiers as distant fighting continues beyond smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: Close chest-mounted dusk POV from behind low earthwork, nearby backs, shields and spear shafts filling foreground, distant smoke barely visible through gaps, no victory composition.
scenes.videoPrompt: Remain low and tired with subtle breathing-driven movement. Do not create a triumphant ending or wide battlefield panorama. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
scenes.audioDirection: Breathing, wind, gear, distant impacts and low environmental battle noise only. No spoken voice or intelligible language.
